meta.title: Deep-sea maid desktop pet
meta.description: Adds a whale-girl desktop pet to the right edge of the Web interface, floating above the composer so its send button stays clickable. She follows the Session in the main view: she dozes and shows that account's balance while nothing runs, switches to a Q-version full body of herself with her hands on her hips, a “just plain rice~” line above her head and a very pleased face, while the Agent is working — she is munching the tokens — raises an alert badge when an approval, plan review, or question waits for you, and hops when a run finishes. She is also hands-on: with her bubble open, click her head, body, or tail for different reactions and to build an affinity level this browser remembers (she hops when it rises); the cake button in her bubble feeds her once every two minutes for more affinity (asking again just gets a reply); while her bubble is open, picking her up and setting her down both make her speak; while idle she murmurs to herself now and then and mentions a low balance, and her bubble's second line shows the affinity level; and she leans toward your pointer unless the system asks for reduced motion. Those interactions are local lines only and cost nothing — model calls happen only when you type in her box: her reply is one short call on your current default model route, at most 220 output tokens and a line or two in character, so every message spends your own model quota. Without a usable model route she answers with one offline line. She cannot run commands, read or write files, browse, or call tools, and she only knows the state and balance shown in her bubble. Chat history lives in this page's memory only and is cleared on reload. Drag her anywhere to place her (remembered), double-click to send her back to the default seat, arrow keys to nudge her while focused, and ✕ in her bubble to collapse it (clicking her again reopens it). She is a frame-wide overlay, so she covers a small area: part of the right panel's rows while that panel is open, and a long draft can grow up under her; clicks and wheel inside her bubble or on her body do not reach what is behind. She hides below 560 px of width. The balance comes from your signed-in DeepSeek account through account/getBalance, refreshed about every 90 seconds while the page is visible and displayed here only: no payment action, and nothing is sent anywhere else. Signed out shows "Not signed in"; without the account service or its access grant she shows "Balance unavailable". Disabling this bundle in Plugins removes the pet, stops the balance reads, and closes the chat route. Artwork: whale girl from the community set "深海女仆工坊" (original character by 上善无形, artwork published by Small-tailqwq), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 — non-commercial use only; full attribution in NOTICE-ARTWORK.md.
